nom: I Dew Care Gold Kitten Revitalizing Golden Peel-Off Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the mask leaves pores tight without adding oiliness, and one notes the thick texture helps because it does not drip on a sweaty T-zone.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one describing extreme dryness, report the mask does not further dry their skin and instead leaves it soft, smooth and hydrated overnight; one gift-sample user, skin type unspecified but with a dryness complaint, found it left her skin very dry after 15 minutes.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers identifying as sensitive report mixed results: several say it caused no irritation or breakouts, one with 'occasionally sensitive' skin found it really hung on and irritated her skin on removal, and one with an alcohol-scented reaction had red cheeks after one use.
segments.mature: One reviewer past menopause reports the mask visibly minimized nose pores and gave an overall younger-looking effect.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the mask for anti-aging or mature-skin concerns report younger-looking, plumper, firmer skin and reduced pore appearance, including one long-time menopausal reviewer citing dramatic pore reduction on the nose; one reviewer notes any anti-aging benefit would need longer-term use to confirm.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the mask as hydrating, soft and non-stripping even on dry or dehydrated skin, and one specifically kept skin hydrated through the night; a smaller number report the opposite, with skin left very dry or peach fuzz removed after one use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports her cheeks turned red after use due to a harsh, alcohol-smelling formula; no other reviewer specifically raises redness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with occasionally sensitive skin found the mask hung onto and irritated her skin on peel-off; most other reviewers, including several sensitive-skin users, report no irritation or stripping.
concerns.spots: Reviewers dealing with acne scars and dark spots report visible fading and more even-looking skin, with one seeing results within the first week and another noting brightened, more even patches after use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone, oily, puffy skin reports the mask helps as part of her routine; no reviewer reports new breakouts from the mask.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the mask does not leave skin oily and instead leaves pores feeling tight and clean, with one specifically noting no oily residue afterward.

aspects.libelle: Thick gloopy texture hard to spread
Peels off in one satisfying piece
Skin feels smooth and soft after peeling

extraits.texte: This mask made me literally cough while applying it becasue the smell of alcohol was that overwhelming. Its also a harsh formula, my cheeks were red after one use

Was curious about the gold in this mask. It is thick from jar not dried out. Pretty easy to spread on. Once dried I started to peel off and ouch. It really hung on to my skin even though I did it slow. Really irritated my occasionally sensitive skin. Would not buy again for this reason. I did like the tight smoothness of my skin. Will try on chest since I have some left.

Gifted by idewcare. A peel off mask?! Say no more. I was so excited to try this and it definitely exceeded my expectations. The smell is a bit strong but I don't have a problem with it since it didn't give my skin any issues. I have sensitive skin so I'm really happy with how this mask didn't break out my skin and how it is fun to peel off haha.

I finally found a replacement for a 24k peel off mask. I was nervous about the reviews, but after using it I instantly fell in love! Yes, the product is thick, so I recommend using the spatula. When you go over the spot, the product softens which makes it easier to spread. The thickness is a plus for me because I sweat a lot throughout my t zone. The mask doesn't drip down my face. I have oily skin, acne prone skin, and my face is puffy. This mask helps as well as my eye mask I sleep with from earth therapeutics. The strong smell is fine for me. Lastly, I left this mask on for over an hour and the peel off was as smooth as butter. Hope this helped someone. I came back to purchase two bottles.

Because I was a really fat kid in the '60s, God showed mercy on me by giving me a perfect complexion. I've never had a zit, blackhead or pore problem, in all of my 63 yrs. Then came menopause. No, no zits, just big pores on my nose. I almost tried Biore, but couldn't bring myself to do it after never needing it. I put a nice layer of this mask on my face, especially my nose. After peeling it off, I didn't recognize my nose!!! Yeah, it worked wonders on the rest of my face, but my nose was transformed!! Not a single visible pore!!! You gotta try this!

I received this complimentary from I dew care. This is the first peel off mask that I have tried, and it was lots of fun using it. I had to wait around 40 minutes for it to dry so I probably had it on to thick. I have dry skin and I saw how nice my skin looked after using this. It looked like the dry skin was removed. The gold color was a nice Suprise and I felt like a queen. But the results were amazing. My skin literally felt like silk. I followed up the treatment with a Niacinamide serum and a retinol moisturizer and the glow definitely is very real! I have sensitive dry skin and I had no irritations at all.

I've tried a lot of products to get rid of my acne scars and dark spots, but these sheet masks gifted by Gold Kitten is the best results so far! I love the scent and how light it feels. It has a cooling sensation and feels very relaxing. I started seeing results within the first week of use. Now my skin is so clear that people constantly seem to think I have a full face of makeup on when it's just my bare skin.
